# langsmith_feedback_formulas (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith feedback formulas scoped to a dataset or a project (session).

Exactly one of `dataset_id` or `session_id` must be set: the LangSmith API rejects an unscoped listing with an HTTP 400.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Feedback formulas scoped to a dataset.
data "langsmith_feedback_formulas" "by_dataset" {
  dataset_id = langsmith_dataset.example.id
}

# Feedback formulas scoped to a project (session).
# Exactly one of dataset_id or session_id may be set.
data "langsmith_feedback_formulas" "by_project" {
  session_id = langsmith_project.example.id
}

output "dataset_formula_keys" {
  value = [for f in data.langsmith_feedback_formulas.by_dataset.formulas : f.feedback_key]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dataset_id` (String) List the feedback formulas scoped to this dataset. Exactly one of `dataset_id` or `session_id` must be set.
- `session_id` (String) List the feedback formulas scoped to this project (session). Exactly one of `dataset_id` or `session_id` must be set.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID to list feedback formulas from. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `formulas` (Attributes List) The matching feedback formulas. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--formulas))

<a id="nestedatt--formulas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `formulas`

Read-Only:

- `aggregation_type` (String) How the formula parts are aggregated (`sum` or `avg`).
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the feedback formula.
- `dataset_id` (String) The dataset the formula is scoped to, if any.
- `feedback_key` (String) The feedback key the formula computes.
- `formula_parts` (String) JSON string of the formula parts. Each part is `{"part_type": "weighted_key", "weight": 1.0, "key": "feedback_key"}`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the feedback formula.
- `modified_at` (String) The last modification timestamp of the feedback formula.
- `session_id` (String) The project (session) the formula is scoped to, if any.
